About us

The Discure System is designed to treat and reverse degenerative disc disease (DDD), healing the disc, reducing pain, and restoring function to patients, via a minimally invasive, implantable bioelectronic approach. Unlike existing treatments, that are symptom-focused, the Discure System is a disease-modifying solution, designed to reduce the use of opioids and the need for invasive back surgery. The company received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation, was selected by FDA for the TAP program, and won multiple awards including for “Best New Technology in Spine Care” at the North American Spine Society (NASS) annual meeting, by a panel of KOL spinal surgeons and neurosurgeons.

    We are pleased to welcome Dr. Ray Baker to Discure Technologies’ Board of Directors. Dr. Baker brings over 30 years of experience in interventional pain, spine care, and medtech innovation. He has held senior leadership roles across both large strategics and high-growth companies, and has played a key role in advancing novel therapies through clinical development, reimbursement, and market adoption. In addition to joining our Board, Dr. Baker will work with Discure in a Chief Medical Officer capacity, supporting our clinical, regulatory, and market-access strategy as we advance toward our next stage. We look forward to working together as we continue to develop a new approach to treating degenerative disc disease. Full release: https://lnkd.in/dSwJbEn3 #DiscureTechnologies #MedTech #Spine #InterventionalPain #DegenerativeDiscDisease #BioelectronicMedicine
